author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Three people were killed and a fourth person was seriously injured in a late-night motorcycle crash in Laconia, according to reporting by Boston 25 News. The collision happened around 11 p.m. near Route 3 and the Looney Bin.

The people who died were identified as Cameron Mosher, 28, of Dennis, Massachusetts; Miles Collette, 32, of Gilford; and Jeanine Fereshetian, 33, of Laconia. A fourth woman was taken to Concord Hospital with life-threatening injuries.

Authorities said there were no immediate indications that speed or alcohol played a role. The crash remained under investigation Monday, and the report did not identify any additional charges or explain what led the motorcycles to collide. The incident is a significant loss for both the Lakes Region and the Massachusetts community where Mosher lived.
The report did not indicate whether weather or road conditions contributed, and officials had not released a fuller reconstruction of the crash.
dek: Authorities say three people died and a fourth person suffered life-threatening injuries in a late-night crash involving motorcycles near Route 3 in Laconia.
headline: Three people killed, including Massachusetts man, in Laconia motorcycle crash
